_about: BACKLOG-4263: every place each run.sh may send a call (call_shape.transport_sites, read by the offline checks and the jest pin). A new $K call site, a sent file built outside these helpers, or an edit to a helper line is red until this file says so.

non_calls: [ -f "$K" ] && [ -x "$K" ] || { echo "refusing: the transport ${K} does not exist or is not executable" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -n "${SQL_TRANSPORT:-}" ] && [ "$K" != "$HOME/.claude/bin/kt-sql" ] || { echo "refusing: GUARD_MARKER_MD5 is only for a non-default SQL_TRANSPORT" >&2; exit 2; }
echo "guard marker substituted for a non-default transport (${K##*/})"
helpers: { cat "$here/guard.sql"; echo; for f in "$@"; do cat "$here/$f"; echo; done; } | fill > "$tmp/$out"
{ cat "$here/hold-marker.sql"; cat "$here/guard.sql"; echo; for f in "$@"; do cat "$here/$f"; echo; done; } | fill > "$tmp/$out"

non_calls: [ -f "$K" ] && [ -x "$K" ] || { echo "refusing: the transport ${K} does not exist or is not executable" >&2; exit 2; }

echo "guard marker substituted for a non-default transport (${K##*/})"
[ -n "$K" ] && [ -x "$K" ] || { echo "refusing: T4263N_RUNNER must name the dry-run transport wrapper (an executable)" >&2; usage; }
case "$(basename "$K")" in kt-sql|kt-sql.*) echo "refusing: T4263N_RUNNER is the hosted transport (${K}); this control commits T-N" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
